node.statement: Node 1.3 gives ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<=40*e, hence ||h bold-dot h-J||<=80*e. Exact unitality and bilinearity give h bold-dot h-J=2a+a bold-dot a. Therefore 2||a||<=80*e+(1+e)||a||^2. Since e,||a||<1/64, the coefficient 2-(1+e)||a|| is at least 63/32, so ||h-J||=||a||<=(2560/63)*e<41*e.
